title: RSI deep-buy: causal confirmations at the RSI low vs the raw touch (card rsi-deep-confirmations, 2869f863)

what.name: Unit
what.value_plain: Stage-0 episode (RSI <= level after >= level+3) on the six TF x level cells H1 did not kill: 60m abs20/abs30/rel, 15m abs30/abs20, 1m abs10
what.label: OURS

what.name: Confirmation
what.value_plain: fires on the first bar within 16 bars of the signal using bars up to that bar only (e.g. new 7d low, higher-TF RSI state); entry = next open, exit = open N bars later (N = 4, 16)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Question
what.value_plain: does waiting for a confirmation beat buying the raw touch?
what.label: OURS

how: 228 confirmation rows (singles and one frozen pair) x cell x N; a row counts only with 30+ independent days (150 on DEV, 80 on VALIDATION).
window: DEV = bar open < 2024-07-01 (frozen first); VALIDATION 2024-07-01..2025-06-30 read once; HOLDOUT never read

verdict.label: NULL: 0 of 150 DEV rows and 0 of 80 VALIDATION rows have a fee-net CI above 0

why: Chance alone would give about 3.8 DEV rows and 2.0 VALIDATION rows above zero; the run found none.
Best DEV row: C8_newlow7d on 60m abs20 N=16, +0.829% [-0.77, +2.43] on 32 days; same row on VALIDATION +0.207% on 13 days (too few days).
Confirmations cut the odds of a new lower low but give up part of the bounce; per event the net stays inside fee noise.
